interpretation: If AUROC>>0.5, precision should rise well above the base rate as recall target is relaxed below the max. Since AUROC~0.46-0.50 (step2), precision at every recall target stays within noise of the 4.0% base rate -- no threshold on accord_contra_prob or accord_harm_score recovers usable precision. This is the operational test of the AUROC finding: a ranking with no signal cannot be rescued by moving the cutoff.

max_precision_anywhere_on_curve_caveat: The 1.0 values above are the trivial edge point sklearn.precision_recall_curve always appends at recall=0 (no predictions made) -- not a genuine top-ranked hit. The actual top-15 highest-scored pairs by both accord_contra_prob and accord_harm_score are ALL pharmacist not_contradiction (0/15 hits, vs ~0.6 expected by chance).
